analysis_role: Post-result missing-state/coverage sensitivity for the already observed unequal relative-lineage-depth pattern. This is not an independent preregistered confirmation and does not estimate evolutionary rate.
question: Could the apparently deeper phyllary history be explained primarily by phyllary having only 10 resolved concepts, versus 20 for orientation and 13 for stickiness?
tree_rule: Keep the full admitted 36-concept topology unchanged. Coverage matching changes only which previously observed tip states remain known; dropped observed states are reset to the full trait-state universe (missing/ambiguous). The relative-depth denominator therefore remains the same 36-tip admitted topology.

orientation.mask_selection: Enumerate every 7-of-14 U x 3-of-6 D mask, hash the sorted retained concept IDs with SHA256 using the literal prefix 'orientation|20260903|', sort by hexadecimal digest, and retain the first 256. This is deterministic and result-blind.

stickiness.primary_mask_selection: exhaustive all 5-of-7 sticky x 5-of-6 nonsticky masks
stickiness.secondary_mask_selection: exhaustive all 6-of-7 sticky x 4-of-6 nonsticky masks; frequency-profile sensitivity only

topology_rule.selection_formula: For k=0..199, use one-based topology index 1 + round(k*999/199), requiring 200 unique indices and including indices 1 and 1000.
topology_rule.reason: Bound computation while spanning the full ordered bootstrap file deterministically. These are topology-sensitivity realizations, not independent biological replicates.

per_topology_estimands: observed phyllary lower bound of mean relative lineage depth among globally minimum-cost histories
orientation coverage-matched lower-bound distribution across 256 deterministic masks: min/q05/median/q95/max and minimum-step distribution
stickiness primary 5/5 coverage-matched lower-bound distribution across all 126 masks: min/q05/median/q95/max and minimum-step distribution
stickiness secondary 6/4 coverage-matched lower-bound distribution across all 105 masks: min/q05/median/q95/max and minimum-step distribution
primary_comparisons: fraction of selected topologies where observed phyllary lower bound is lower (deeper-permissive) than the orientation matched-mask median
fraction of selected topologies where observed phyllary lower bound is lower than the orientation matched-mask q05 (strict coverage-robust comparison)
fraction of selected topologies where observed phyllary lower bound is lower than the stickiness 5/5 matched-mask median
fraction of selected topologies where observed phyllary lower bound is lower than the stickiness 5/5 matched-mask q05
secondary_comparisons: repeat stickiness comparisons using the 6/4 state-frequency profile
report the distribution of minimum steps after masking to show how much information loss accompanies coverage matching

descriptive_labels.robust: prespecified direction on >=0.95 of the 200 selected topology realizations

interpretation_rules.coverage_robust_reading: If phyllary remains deeper than the strict q05 coverage-matched distribution on most topology realizations, reduced observed-state coverage alone is insufficient to explain the depth ordering under this masking design.
interpretation_rules.coverage_sensitive_reading: If coverage matching commonly makes orientation or stickiness as deep as or deeper than observed phyllary, the unequal-depth headline must be qualified as missing-state/coverage sensitive.
interpretation_rules.ontology_boundary: Even a coverage-robust result does not make the three traits commensurable evolutionary-rate estimands because their state ontologies differ.

fail_closed_rules: Abort if the exact frozen ML/UFBoot hashes or declared tree artifact provenance differ.
Abort unless the unmasked source state counts are exactly orientation 14 U / 6 D, phyllary 10 resolved concepts, and stickiness 7 sticky / 6 nonsticky.
Abort unless the orientation deterministic mask set contains exactly 256 unique masks and the two stickiness exhaustive sets contain exactly 126 and 105 unique masks.
Abort unless topology selection produces exactly 200 unique one-based indices including 1 and 1000.
Do not replace dropped observations by the opposite state; they become fully ambiguous only.
Do not use topology x mask combinations as independent replicates or compute a P value from them.
Do not alter the frozen main relative-depth result or PR #160 paired-topology analysis based on this sensitivity; report it as a separate post-result robustness layer.
claim_boundary: Coverage matching tests sensitivity to missing observed states, not sampling bias in authority descriptions or taxonomic representativeness.
A coverage-robust ordering does not establish equal lability, evolutionary rates, independent origins, adaptation, genetic modularity or a causal mechanism.
A coverage-sensitive ordering would weaken the unequal-depth interpretation but would not erase the frozen minimum-change histories themselves.
Bootstrap/topology fractions and mask quantiles are deterministic sensitivity summaries, not posterior probabilities or confidence levels.
